 Pakistan vs England, ODI tri-series LIVE! Latest cricket score, updates, video and analysis as Harry Brook's side target first win 
 England lost first two matches of tri-series - an 87-run defeat to Pakistan and then a two-wicket reverse against Sri Lanka as they failed to defend a score of 429-4; another loss in Lahore today would leave Harry Brook's side on the brink of elimination; watch live on Sky Sports Cricket
